BiblicalUsage: Jahdai was of the house of Caleb, and the father of Regem and Jotham and Gesham and Pelet and Ephah and Shaaph. He stands in the genealogy of Judah, one of the sons of the Calebite line.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jahdai's six sons are six reasons the tribe of Caleb endured, and God keeps the sons of Caleb by name.
